conditions.world_generation: Road endpoint changes apply only to roads planned for ungenerated chunks

conditions.road_scope: Only the Overworld and exact surface structure IDs in the native RoadWeaver allowlist are eligible

change.summary: Remove Fog, Immersive Storms, Moog's Mineshafts integration and Luxium, then route RoadWeaver only to selected surface Overworld structures

modifiers.before: Moog's Mineshafts integration records remained after its runtime artifact was removed
modifiers.after: Hopo Better Mineshaft and vanilla mineshafts are the only active mineshaft quest and localization owners

modifiers.before: Luxium was absent from the managed pack but JEMLuxium source, Sandbox scope and public release records remained active
Village tag and vanilla pillager outpost across Overworld, Nether and End prediction dimensions
modifiers.after: Overworld-only exact allowlist of villages, land outposts, selected surface settlements, towers, ruins and surface-projected boss arenas

cause.owner: JEM managed distribution, native RoadWeaver configuration and active integration catalogs

rationale.purpose: Remove rejected weather and renderer integrations, keep one mineshaft owner and extend roads without sending players to underground or non-Overworld structures
rationale.decision_source: The user requested removal of Fog, Immersive Storms, Moog's Mineshafts Reimagined and all Luxium-related active scope, then approved an Overworld surface-only RoadWeaver allowlist with surface bosses
rationale.implementation_choices: Retain historical records as superseded evidence, replace Moog quest proof with installed vanilla and Hopo registry IDs, and use exact installed structure IDs because RoadWeaver has no general underground-classification filter

introduced.summary: Remove the four rejected integrations and configure RoadWeaver for selected surface Overworld destinations

history.summary: Delete active Fog, Immersive Storms, Moog and Luxium surfaces, migrate the mineshaft proof owner and publish an exact RoadWeaver surface allowlist

relations: Hopo Better Mineshaft remains the dedicated mineshaft overhaul
Structure Layout Optimizer remains the jigsaw assembly optimizer
Structurify remains the placement and overlap owner
notes: Ocean, ocean-floor, cave, deep-underground, Nether, End and sky-only structures are absent from the RoadWeaver allowlist
Existing generated road blocks are not removed
unresolved: Fresh-chunk RoadWeaver endpoint density and visual acceptance require authorized gameplay review
